patch_description: This candidate blends the strongest elements from the prior runs: symmetry-shared single-qubit rotations plus a compact, parametrized entangling layer using CRX on the sparse ring edges and CRZ spokes to the hub. Parameters are shared across symmetric positions (corners, edges, center; periphery vs center output) to remain parameter-efficient. The mixing RX is shared globally to keep the parameter count low while promoting wide mixing. This crossover yields the same compact parameterization (9 unique parameters per block -> 54 total parameters) and merges the effective parametrized entanglers from the better-performing scripts with the symmetry-aware single-qubit motif from the seed. The rest of the program, training loop, feature map, data construction, and measurements are unchanged.
